scope: Purposive48-disease panel; finite reference set after identity review, NOT all rare-disease development
reason_estimator_not_run: First-human inception, complete program ascertainment, per-indication identity and continuous outcome follow-up are not jointly verified; current unknowns are not valid independent right-censoring times.
interpretation: A/N is observed approvals to date among selected proxy-entry records. Envelopes assume all observed stops stay stopped and unresolved rows can either approve or not. They ignore sampling uncertainty and do not estimate CMP-002 PoS. The25% hurdle is arithmetic, not a calibrated forecast.
